tbesh_html:
1) to run, run about, rush, run to and fro, be eager or greedy or thirsty
1a) (Qal) roving, ranging, longing, rush out upon (participle)
1b) (Hithpalpel) to rush to and fro, rush back and forth

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to course (like a beast of prey); by implication, to seek greedily
strongs_1890.kjv_def: have appetite, justle one against another, long, range, run (to and fro).
